plan.line: a ball tilt switch (SW-520D): closed while it stands upright, open when it is tilted or shaken. Use it to notice tilting, tipping over or shaking; it can't measure an angle.

code.pinLine: tilt switch {ref} on {gpio}: Pin({g}, Pin.IN, Pin.PULL_UP). value() is 0 while it stands upright (the ball closes the contact) and 1 while it is tilted. While it is being shaken the ball bounces, so the value flickers: to count a tilt, wait until it has read 1 for about 50 ms.
code.ragQuery: GPIO digital input with pull-up resistor
